job.meaning: дедушка ~78 во дворе: тёмная кепка, седая щетина, тёмное пальто, уличное интервью
job.prompt: Vertical 9:16 photorealistic street-interview frame of a kind, wise Russian elderly man about 78 with a dark flat cap, short grey stubble, deep wrinkles, gentle tired eyes, a dark wool coat over a grey knit sweater. He looks slightly to the left of the camera at the interviewer, mid-sentence, lips slightly parted, calm and thoughtful, NO smile. Close-medium shot: head and shoulders, face large and sharp, top of the cap about 14% below the upper edge, both shoulders inside the frame. Background: a quiet residential courtyard with old apartment blocks and bare autumn trees, overcast light, blurred. Look: a real frame from a high-end camera, true-to-life colours, natural skin texture, NOT CGI, NOT a glamour retouch. No text, no logos, no watermark.
